messages:
sarah_sales: Hey team — new deal (GlobalBank) wants a short POC for a fully air-gapped on-prem deployment. They asked for: offline installer, signing, 6mo upgrade cadence allowed, and a license exception for our telemetry. Can SE/security confirm feasibility and any blockers?

mike_se: Yep, we can do an air-gapped POC. Need to confirm: target infra (k8s bare-metal vs single VM), GPU/CPU profile, and whether they accept delta patches or only full re-bundles. Also: what's their expected uptime SLA during POC?

jenna_cust: single k8s cluster (RHEL 8), 4 nodes, 2x A100s total. No outbound egress at all. POC SLA is just functional (no uptime SLA), but we need support during install week.

alejandro_sec: Important security asks from their InfoSec: SBOM for every bundle, signed artifacts, offline activation tokens, and ability to supply customer-managed signing keys (or verify our signatures against a CA they control). Also they want KMS integration with on-prem HSM for customer keys.

kyle_eng: For signing we support signed tarballs + detached sigs. We can provide SHA256 checksums and .sig files. For HSM/KMS, our Private deploy supports customer KMS via KMIP/HSM or Cloud EKM, but that needs extra config and a short design doc.

mike_se: Actionable checklist I propose: 1) We produce airgap bundle (tar.gz) + sha256 + sig. 2) SBOM (CycloneDX) attached per build. 3) Offline activation token flow (time-limited). 4) Install guide for RHEL k8s (manifests + helm). 5) Rollback plan (node drain + reapply previous bundle). Any concerns?

laura_legal: On telemetry: GlobalBank requires a licensing exception to disable outbound telemetry for the POC and wants a contractual confirmation we won't collect data. Legal can do a scoped addendum but need Product to confirm product-level ability to disable pings entirely.

alejandro_sec: We can toggle telemetry at build/runtime flags, but must ensure no accidental egress (CRL checks, update checks). Recommend we ship with update checks disabled and a hard-coded allowlist for cert verification. Also audit the installer so it doesn't attempt DNS resolution.

mike_se: Noted — we'll default the bundle with update checks off and document the config flags. For patch cadence they asked 6 months — that's longer than our normal. We should propose a security-only patch channel if they insist on that cadence. Kyle, can we produce delta patches for CVE backports, or will we need full bundle re-upload?

kyle_eng: We currently support both: small delta patches (binary diffs for runtime) for minor updates, and full bundle for major. For air-gapped customers we typically produce signed delta packages and a script to apply them offline. Need to confirm size limits — diffs typically <100MB, full bundles ~1.2GB.

jenna_cust: Size is fine. They only allow scheduled maintenance windows once per quarter and require rollback tested. Also they require that we provide an offline rollback artifact and a tested runbook.

mike_se: We'll prepare: install runbook, offline rollback script, delta patching flow, SBOM, signed artifacts, and a telemetry-disable addendum draft for Legal. Estimated lead time to produce POC bundle & docs: 7 business days.

laura_legal: Sounds good. I'll draft the addendum and share with Sarah for customer signature. One ask: SLA for POC support week — can Support allocate an hours-per-day rota?

sarah_sales: Yes please — 2 hours overlap/day for 5 days would be ideal. I'll coordinate.

deploy-bot: Note: airgap-bundle build job queued (#build-5423). ETA 3 days for first candidate. :truck: :package:

mike_se: I'll open a short PR with the install manifests and an example `sha256sum` verification snippet: 
```
sha256sum redwood-airgap-1.2.0.tar.gz
# expected: 3b7f2e9a...caf
gpg --verify redwood-airgap-1.2.0.tar.gz.sig redwood-airgap-1.2.0.tar.gz
```

alejandro_sec: Also include instructions for offline cert trust (how to add our CA to their nodes) and an HSM/KMIP config sample.

mike_se: Will do. Thanks everyone — next steps: build candidate, Security to review SBOM/signing, Legal to draft telemetry addendum, Sales to schedule install week. I'll update this thread with the build link when ready. :thumbsup:
